opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a platform that provides “100% earning” and gives prospective participants a direct WhatsApp route to join. It reinforces that recruitment-and-return message by associating reported earnings with “13 Direct Members” and displaying a Forsage screen with profits alongside partner and team counts. Together, these elements promote participation through tiered recruitment and anticipated returns. The supplied frames do not show the joining terms or any completed transaction, so the evidence does not establish those details.
